about: Licence information scripts/notices.ts cannot read from node_modules. Texts are under texts/, verbatim from the upstream source named in each entry. An entry is keyed by the version of the package it applies to: after an upgrade the build fails until the entry is checked and its version updated.

missingText.name: react-compiler-runtime
missingText.why: The package declares MIT and its files say "licensed under the MIT license found in the LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree" (facebook/react), but the npm package has no LICENSE file. This is that repository's MIT licence, as in the react package.
